feeds.title: North Texas Farm and Ranch
feeds.description: Each month North Texas Farm & Ranch will take you inside the lives of local farmers and ranchers. The magazine will provide information on everything from the newest farm equipment to the latest western trends. North Texas Farm & Ranch showcases this community's hardworking lifestyle, events affecting the area and the great outdoors surrounding it.

feeds.title: West and Swope Ranches Blog
feeds.description: At West & Swope Ranches, we pride ourselves on developing personal relationships with our clients that extend well beyond the buying or selling of a ranch. We aim to work with clients who share our passion and respect for the land and the heritage that it represents.

feeds.title: Texas Hunting Land
feeds.description: Texas Hunting Land, LLC was established in 1998 as one of the first real estate brokerages to service clients looking to buy and sell recreational property with an emphasis on Internet marketing. Its strong network with its multiple offices combined with its impeccable track record allows the company's sales associates to offer quality brokerage services and innovative marketing to its clients and customers.

feeds.title: Texas Ranch Journal Blog
feeds.description: For over five years, Texas Ranch Journal has explored topics relating to the true Texas heritage, ranching. From hunting and fishing to operating a cattle or deer operation, land improvements, farming, agriculture, protecting your land investment, and more.

feeds.title: Farm & Ranch Magazine
feeds.description: At FarmandRanch.com, visitors can enjoy immediate access to thousands of rural properties for sale, including those featured in the Farm & Ranch print publications, properties uploaded directly to the site by industry-leading ranch real estate brokers and agents, and real estate listings found in our user-friendly Farm & Ranch digital magazines.

feeds.title: Nine Bar Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Our blog features articles on hunting tips and techniques and various animals for hunting the surrounding Texas wilderness. The Nine Bar Ranch is owned by the Waggoner-Sauder family, a fixture in the Texas ranching community since the early 1900's. The ranch is comprised of over 12,000 acres of beautiful Texas scenery.

feeds.title: Dead Cat Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Jerry Spencer founded Dead Cat Ranch more than 40 years ago. The beautiful scenery, a variety of fun and relaxing activities, and our comfortable and unique lodging create the perfect East Texas oasis. Keep up with the latest news at Dead Cat Ranch, or read the latest blog posts about the best place to unplug and unwind in Palestine, Texas.

feeds.title: TexasLand Blog
feeds.description: We know that investing in real estate is an undertaking that can feel as big as Texas, which is why we proudly feature a team of realtors who are experts in the ranch and land market. With local, on-the-ground expertise and the global reach of the nation's largest real estate brokerage company, TexasLand is in an unparalleled position to help you sell or buy your next investment, live-water, raw land or hunting ranch.

feeds.title: Fredericksburg Ranch Realty Blog
feeds.description: We are a family-owned realty business based in Fredericksburg. Over the years, we've helped families and investors discover the properties of their dreams, from second homes to sprawling ranches and everything in between. Our clients feel secure because of our honest and collective effort on clients' property.

feeds.title: Boot Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Boot Ranch is exclusively for members and their guests, with a 24-hour attended guardhouse. Whether you're looking for a second home, a place to retire, or a great place to raise a family, Boot Ranch has exceptional real estate from which to choose. Take a look into the life of our members, learn about our amenities and more!
